correctness.rationale: In the full-occupancy finite chain, from each nonempty state there is a positive-probability path of only extinctions to the absorbing state, so each transient backward system is invertible at every positive rate. The independent replay builds the full 15-state backward matrix for each graph and solves it symbolically over the rate variable without orbit lumping. The four rational functions and both factored differences match. The cycle-minus-paw sign is the sign of F: the denominator is positive, F has exactly one descending coefficient sign change, and its constant and leading terms have opposite signs. Exact endpoint substitution verifies the bracket and exact evaluation at rate two gives 237101/648778. The two adjacency characteristic polynomials give strict paw superiority since x³−x²−3x+1 changes sign between 2 and 3. With three links, the star has larger spectral radius than the path, and the numerator of star-minus-path is a positive-coefficient polynomial times λ² over positive factors. At n≤3 each nonempty connected fixed-size stratum has one type. At n=4 the lower link stratum is the tree pair, and the four-link pair arises by removing two adjacent or two disjoint edges from the complete graph. This verifies both levels of minimality under the stated constraints.
residual_risks: Only binary homogeneous links, independent unit-rate local extinctions, per-neighbor colonization and full initial occupancy are covered. The result does not order all survival distributions or other initial states.

checked_sources: RESULT.md Finding, scope and sharp minimality proof; independent full-state symbolic replay; all-small-graph and later catalogue comparisons above
value.rationale: Equal order and size hold the patch and link budgets fixed for a motivated comparison of two inequivalent persistence measures. The minimality theorem isolates the first structural obstruction and excludes a reversal on either four-patch tree at any positive rate. The crossover certificate says precisely on what rate side the spectral ranking fails, not just that a counterexample can occur. Value is in the combined sharp boundary and comparison, not in recomputing all small-graph lifetimes or asserting a new general ecological phenomenon.
residual_risks: Does not interpret the original spatially weighted metric as universally equivalent to this binary proxy or establish an empirical conservation rule.
